subject: Handoff: CareWell onboarding & implementation plan — next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Stone <michael.stone@carewellhealth.com>, Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@carewellhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Mar 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: CareWell onboarding & implementation plan — next steps

Team,

Quick handoff for CareWell (signed last week). Summarized the essentials below so CS can take lead on kickoff and delivery planning. Michael / Asha — looping you in so you see the plan; Tessa will be your primary contact from Redwood for onboarding.

Deal snapshot
- ACV: $480k (12 months) — Dedicated capacity + hosted fallbacks
- Go-live target: 2028-04-28 (customer-driven)
- Signed SOW: CareWell_SOW_v2.pdf (attached)
- Deal id: DEAL-2028-0192 (HubSpot link in metadata)

Key requirements / constraints- Private VPC peering to CareWell network (dedicated cluster)
- Customer-managed KMS for key material
- Data retention policy: 90 days for logs, 30 days for payloads (customer request)- SOC 2 evidence requested during onboarding (customer asked for SOC 2 Type II + encryption at rest detail)
- Integrations: SSO (SAML), SCIM for provisioning, and a direct webhook for prediction events

Open items / must-have before kickoff
1) Signed SOW (attached) + PO to finance (Michael noted procurement timeline: PO by Apr 10)
2) Network contact for peering: Asha (cc'd) to share IP space and firewall window
3) List of first three prod endpoints to seed (they prefer payments, claims, and triage APIs)

Proposed next steps- Tessa, can you own primary CS contact and schedule a 60-minute kickoff with CareWell (intro + security + timeline + owners)?- Recommend internal pre-call for ops + infra to confirm capacity/provisioning details before customer kickoff — Vivek, Karthik: can you join?

I’ve attached the SOW and a starter deployment matrix. I can jump on the kickoff if useful for introductions.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments:
- CareWell_SOW_v2.pdf
- carewell_deployment_matrix.xlsx

Thanks Kim — happy to take point.

Proposed: 60-minute kickoff on Tue, Mar 28 at 10:00 AM PT (we'll cover security, network, timeline, roles, and quick demo). Michael / Asha — does that time work for you? If not, please share two alternate 1-hour windows next week.

Internal: Vivek, Karthik — I'll set a 30-minute pre-call on Mon Mar 27 10:00 AM PT to align on capacity & provisioning.

I’ll prepare a kickoff agenda and a short checklist for required artifacts (network info, PO, SOC 2 request).

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan

Date: Tue, 21 Mar 2028 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: CareWell provisioning notes (do not forward)

Internal note — please keep internal until we validate with customer:
- Dedicated cluster required: plan for 4x A100-equivalent nodes to meet latency SLO for expected peak qps. (Estimate included in deployment matrix.)
- Need to reserve capacity window by Apr 3 to hit provisioning lead times for dedicated hardware.
- KMS integration: customer will use AWS KMS in their account; we need a security design doc and key-rotation plan.
- Networking: request that Asha provide the CIDR blocks and an approved firewall window; peering will require a support ticket to infra with netops runbook.
- Procurement: finance needs PO reference and billing contact to finalize dedicated capacity activation.

I'll coordinate with infra and confirm whether we can use a warm standby pool for the first two weeks post-go-live.

-Vivek
Head of Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
